verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer has a dedicated Data privacy focus-area page. It claims more CIPPs than any comparable firm and says the firm has drafted more privacy policies and negotiated more privacy and security contract provisions for emerging companies than any other firm. Its strategic transactions page also names data privacy as a core part of its licensing and commercial team. Missing for 10: explicit mention of specific regimes (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP or local equivalents), evidence of cybersecurity or breach-response counsel, and independent corroboration of the practice.
